_info: Source de traduction de Better Weaponry. Les noms d'armes sont construits avec 'pattern' : {type} et {material} sont remplacés par les noms ci-dessous ({type|lower} = première lettre en minuscule). Un matériau peut avoir une forme par genre (clé = 'gender' du type) et son propre 'pattern'. 'overrides' force le nom d'un objet précis. Après modification : gradlew runData.

strings.better_weaponry.configuration.show_attac: Show the 'Attack Reach' stat on weapon tooltips.
strings.better_weaponry.configuration.show_two_h: Show 'Two Handed' on tooltips of two-handed weapons.
strings.better_weaponry.configuration.show_combo: Show the combo progress dots under the crosshair.
strings.better_weaponry.tooltip.ability.parry.du: Also parries with a weapon in each hand
strings.better_weaponry.tooltip.ability.dash.inp: Goes in the direction you are moving
strings.better_weaponry.tooltip.combo.requires_d: Combo with the same weapon in each hand
strings.better_weaponry.data.problems.header: [Better Weaponry] %s problem(s) in the weapon files:
strings.better_weaponry.data.problem.not_an_obje: %1$s: the file must contain a JSON object { ... }, file ignored
strings.better_weaponry.data.problem.io: %1$s: the file could not be read (%2$s)
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.format_vers: Version of the file format. Leave it at 1.
true: while the weapon is in the main hand, the off hand is hidden and cannot be used, and the weapon cannot be dual wielded.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.attack_spee: Attacks per second at full strength (vanilla sword: 1.6). Above 2, part of the hits on a single target are lost to its invulnerability time.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.attack_reac: How far away you can hit entities, in blocks (vanilla: 3).
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.base_damage: Damage of the wooden version, as shown on the tooltip. Each material multiplies it by its own factor (stone ×1.25, iron ×1.5, diamond ×1.75, netherite ×2, gold ×1) and rounds it to the nearest half point.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.material_da: Forces the damage of some materials, for example { "golden": 6 }. Materials that are not listed use base_damage × their factor.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.armor_penet: Percentage of the target's armor ignored by this weapon's hits (0 = armor works normally, 100 = armor is ignored). Melee hits only. Shown on the tooltip when above 0.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.disables_sh: true: like an axe, a hit on a raised shield disables it for 5 seconds.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.on_hit_effe: Effects given to the target that is hit, for example slowness. List of objects: [ { "effect": "minecraft:slowness", "duration_seconds": 2 } ].
Id of the effect, for example minecraft:slowness, minecraft:weakness or minecraft:poison.
Duration of the effect, in seconds.
Level of the effect (1 = Slowness I, 2 = Slowness II...).
Chance to give the effect on each hit, in % (100 = always).
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.sweep.help: The sweep attack that also hits the enemies around the target (fully charged hit, on the ground, without sprinting).
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.sweep.enabl: false: this weapon never makes a sweep attack (thrusting weapons).
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.sweep.radiu: Size of the zone around the target, in blocks (vanilla sword: 1). Still limited by the attack reach.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.sweep.damag: Damage of the sweep attack, in % of the weapon's damage (0 = 1 damage, like a vanilla sword without Sweeping Edge). Adds up with Sweeping Edge.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.ability.hel: What a right click does with this weapon in the main hand: "parry" (hold to block part of the damage, like swords in Minecraft 1.8), "dash" (a quick leap) or "none" (the right click keeps its normal action).
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.parry.help: Settings of the parry, used when ability is "parry". While right click is held, you move slowly and the hits you take from the front are reduced. Only works with the off hand empty, with a two-handed weapon, or with a weapon in the off hand if while_dual_wielding is true. A shield in the off hand is raised instead.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.parry.damag: Part of the damage blocked, in % (100 = no damage). Hits from behind, falls, fire, poison and other damage that a shield cannot block are not reduced.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.parry.durab: Durability lost per point of damage blocked, rounded, at least 1 per parried hit (0 = parrying never wears the weapon out).
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.parry.while: true: the parry also works with a weapon in the off hand (made for the sais). false: the off hand must be empty.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.dash.help: Settings of the dash, used when ability is "dash". A right click throws you forward, then the weapon type has a cooldown (shown on the hotbar, shared by every material). Only works with the off hand empty or holding a weapon, never while riding, gliding with an elytra or in water or lava.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.dash.distan: Approximate length of the dash on flat ground, in blocks. Farther on ice or in mid-air.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.dash.cooldo: Time before the next dash, in seconds. Shared by every material of this weapon type.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.dash.direct: "look": where you are looking (lunge). "input": where you are moving with the movement keys, for example sideways to dodge; forward if no key is held.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.dash.allow_: true: the dash also works while jumping or falling. false: you must be on the ground.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.dash.hunger: Food used by each dash, in food points (1 = half a drumstick; a sprint jump uses about 0.05). Above 0, the dash is impossible when the hunger bar is at 3 drumsticks or less, like sprinting.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.combo.help: A series of hits that repeats, with special hits. Each hit that lands moves the combo forward; a swing that hits nothing does not count. Special hits are always made with the main-hand weapon.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.combo.enabl: true: this weapon has a combo.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.combo.requi: true: the combo only exists with the same weapon type in the other hand (dual wielding). false: the combo also works with this weapon alone.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.combo.reset: The combo starts over after this many seconds without landing a hit. Switching weapons also resets it.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.combo.min_c: A hit charged below this percentage (attack indicator under the crosshair) resets the combo, so spamming clicks does not work. 0 = every hit counts.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.combo.steps: The hits of the combo, in order; after the last one, it starts over. {} = normal hit. Example: [ {}, {}, { "radius": 3.5, "angle": 360 } ] = the 3rd hit strikes all around.
true: if the off hand holds the same weapon type, this hit strikes with both weapons at once: both arms swing, damage = average of the two weapons, effects and wear of both weapons.
0 = normal hit on the target. Above 0, the hit also strikes every enemy within this distance, in blocks, and replaces the sweep attack.
Width of the area in front of you, in degrees (90 = narrow cone, 180 = half circle, 360 = all around). Only used with a radius.
Damage of this hit × this value (1 = normal, 1.5 = 50% more).
Extra knockback of this hit, in levels of the Knockback enchantment (1 = like Knockback I).
Cooldown of the next hit × this value (1.6 = 60% longer): a strong finisher takes time to recover from.
strings.better_weaponry.field.rules.format_versi: Version of the file format. Leave it at 1.
strings.better_weaponry.field.rules.dual_wield_s: Attack speed multiplier while holding a weapon in each hand (1.5 = 50% faster).
strings.better_weaponry.field.rules.dual_wield_i: How long a target ignores new hits after a hit made while holding a weapon in each hand, in seconds (vanilla: 0.5). Lower values let fast weapons such as daggers land every hit.
strings.better_weaponry.field.rules.parry_enable: false: no weapon can parry, whatever its file says (the right click keeps its normal action).
strings.better_weaponry.field.rules.dash_enabled: false: no weapon can dash, whatever its file says (the right click keeps its normal action).
strings.better_weaponry.field.rules.combos_enabl: false: no weapon has a combo, whatever its file says.
strings.better_weaponry.doc.readme.title: Better Weaponry: weapon settings
strings.better_weaponry.doc.readme.intro: This folder changes the stats of the Better Weaponry weapons for all your worlds. Your files only contain what you change: everything else keeps the mod's default values, even after an update.
strings.better_weaponry.doc.readme.folders:
What is in this folder:
  weapons/          one file per weapon type: add the fields you want to change.
  rules.json        global rules (dual wielding...).
  defaults/         the mod's default values, rewritten at every launch. Read them and copy fields from them, but do not edit them.
  *.schema.json     used by code editors such as VS Code: autocompletion, help when hovering a field, errors underlined.
  README.txt        this file, rewritten at every launch in the game's language.
strings.better_weaponry.doc.readme.errors: If a value is invalid (wrong type, out of range), it is ignored and the previous value is kept. Errors are shown in the chat to operators and to the host of a single-player game, and written to logs/latest.log. Comments starting with // are allowed, and so are keys starting with _ (for example "_note").
